entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in 2022 and operated through the XBO.com platform by Curaçao-incorporated Clickjoint B.V., with additional registrations disclosed for affiliated entities.
entity.notes: Current first-party privacy and licensing pages identify Clickjoint B.V. in Curaçao and disclose additional Canadian and Mauritian registrations. A separate About-page statement references Polish law, so HEI uses the disclosed operating-company jurisdiction and avoids asserting a single global licence. CoinGecko reports current markets and a 2022 establishment year; January 1 is a year-level marker.

evidence.title: XBO.com Privacy Policy and operator disclosure
evidence.notes: Current first-party policy identifies Clickjoint B.V. as the Curaçao-incorporated company operating XBO.com and confirms the website, applications, and exchange-related services.

evidence.title: XBO.com exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile reports a 2022 establishment year, hundreds of listed markets, and continuing tracked trading activity.
